title: Popeye

exclude: VIC bitmap color cells cleared at startup by $4C6A before the controls menu, then painted by $835A and $4F2A
$4C6A clears all bitmap pages before the menu. $8362 and $4F69 paint the bitmap from source glyph and tile data
Fill and retained memory from packing. POPEYE 1986 clears the entire range, with zero CPU reads through the first room draw and matching bitmap samples including the apparent copies from this range
Repeating fill between the effect and music banks. POPEYE 1986 replaces it with zeroes, with both banks intact and zero reads from the range through the first room draw
Exact copy of BASIC ROM 901226-01 offsets $0000–$015F in both the entry and play snapshots
Physical RAM beneath the KERNAL GETIN entry contains a power-on pattern in the selected load and zeroes in the G-FORCE copy. The menu invokes GETIN with KERNAL ROM visible
include: Physical RAM scratch and planar scenery cache written by the room renderer with I/O hidden

io: Clear mask bits in the room cache in the RAM beneath I/O
Scenery generation writes the room cache in RAM with I/O hidden
Copy nine pages of the room cache from physical RAM
